evaluator_boundary: INTERNAL_VIRTUAL_EVALUATION; same-session project-aware evaluator, not independent blind.

strengths: Safety, funding/payroll, documentary evidence, community-space negotiation, and outdoor-performance threads converge causally rather than as isolated subplots.
Relationship changes are repeatedly carried by observable procedures/props: disclosure of documents, responsibility table, safety tape, floor plans, signed agreements, and shared evidence custody.
Episode ending distinguishes achieved present action from unresolved long-horizon debt instead of falsely closing the building/funding/family problems.
weaknesses: Electrical/document evidence investigation recurs across SQ03, SQ05, and SQ08; each adds information, but the aggregate rhythm can feel procedurally repetitive.
Several middle sequences are document/verification heavy, so escalation sometimes advances through paperwork rather than sharper interpersonal reversals.
Some dialogue cadences share the same concise adversarial pattern across characters, leaving room for stronger voice differentiation.

scene_sample.interpretation: Internal sample clears the preregistered internal threshold. Strongest areas are physicalization, information dramatization, and world-specific procedural action. Voice/subtext are adequate-to-strong but remain the main literary-quality uncertainty for external blind review.

final_boundary: This result cannot substitute for independent external blind evaluation and does not qualify Production, Operational Level-3, or R140.
